container: UTOK1: magic 'UTOK1\n' (6B), u32le entry count, then per entry varint(len)+raw token bytes; rank = entry index (contiguous, assert at pack time). Whole file zstd -19 -> data/<name>.bin.zst

qwen3.note: HF vocab id 0 decodes to '｜', so the vocabulary strings are not the plain GPT-2 byte alphabet; the packer resolves their encoding before packing.

deepseek3.source: cache/deepseek-v4.tokenizer.json (base BPE identical V3..V4, verified: same 128000 vocab + 127741 merges hash)

kimi_k2.patternNote: uses class intersection && plus lookahead; from tokenization_kimi.py

glm5.source: cache/glm-5.tokenizer.json (zai-org/GLM-5; superset of GLM-4.x, ids preserved)

gemma4.source: google/gemma-4-12B-it tokenizer.json at 43c9d014b231474fa7212dbb48a762566c2b255d, sha256 9788bdb6a021b3170357cd3587b5d622b1177561ad3c5bf43d73728fd71aeacb; packed in this crate by tools/pack-gemma.py, not by Oh My Pi
gemma4.model: BPE over characters, byte_fallback true, ignore_merges false; merge priority is the merges list order
gemma4.note: The pre-tokenizer splits on a space after the normalizer has turned every space into U+2581, so the whole text is one word.
gemma4.vocab_container: GVOCAB1: magic 'GVOCAB1\n' (8B), u32le piece count, then each piece's UTF-8 bytes followed by a NUL; index = token id; an empty piece is a slot no count uses. Whole file zstd -19 -> data/gemma4_vocab.bin.zst
gemma4.merges_container: GMERGE1: magic 'GMERGE1\n' (8B), u32le merge count, then per merge in rank order varint(zigzag(produced id - previous produced id, starting from 0)) + varint(byte length of the left half of the produced piece). Whole file zstd -19 -> data/gemma4_merges.bin.zst
